description:
Candidates must be able to pass an online technical java test 
 MUST HAVE: 

 5+ years Java programming experience 

 3+ years development using Microsoft SQL including
 Strong experience writing complex queries in SQL
 Experience creating joins
 Demonstrated competency in accurately identifying the scope of work and preparing thorough, accurate, and detailed schedule estimates
 Demonstrated competency in designing, programming, and unit testing complex n-Tier applications
 Demonstrated competency in producing clear and thorough technical documentation
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to express complex technical concepts in business terms
  BS / BA in MIS, Computer Science, Business, Mathematics, Engineering or related field
 Demonstrated experience with taking initiative to provide input and resolve issues and problems proactively
 Demonstrated ability to quickly grasp new concepts, both technical and business related, and to apply these concepts as needed
 Demonstrated ability to effectively manage and prioritize multiple assignments
 NICE TO HAVE: 
 Experience working in the restaurant or food services industry (strongly preferred) 

 Experience developing or maintaining point-of-sale (POS) systems
 Preferably using Java on a POS System
 J2SE 1.6/1.7
 MVC Pattern
 Servlets
 JSP
 RMI
 AWT
 Spring
 Tomcat 5.5/7
 Microsoft SQL Server 2005/2008
 Apache CXF
 Eclipse
 Subversion
 Jenkins
 JUnit
 JavaDoc
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration:  6+ Months 
   Interview Mode: Phone and SKYPE 

 
 NEED LOCALS CANDIDATES
